offers.name: Dead lead reactivation pilot
offers.audience: Owners and leaders of midsize recruiting and staffing firms with years of past clients in their ATS.
offers.promise: I turn the past clients and cold contacts in your ATS into new job orders in 30 days, free.
youGet: Every past client and dormant hiring contact in your ATS, cleaned and checked.
A reactivation campaign written in your recruiter's voice, sent from a new domain in their name. Your main domain is never touched.
Replies sorted and handed to your recruiter the same day.
A weekly report: replies, meetings, job orders.
youGive: An export of past clients and contacts from your ATS or CRM.
One recruiter's name and signature on the emails.
Your real numbers at the end, job orders and fees, so we both know what it was worth.
weGet: The results as a case study, named or anonymous, your call.
Introductions to firms you know, if it worked.
Straight feedback on what it was worth to you.
offers.guarantee: You keep the cleaned list, the copy and the domain whatever happens.

questions.ask: How many recruiters do you have?
Roughly how many past clients and hiring contacts sit in your ATS or CRM?
What's holding growth back right now? Pick any.

choices.label: BD depends on one or two people
Inbound leads wait too long for a reply

offers.name: Candidate reactivation
offers.audience: Recruiting firms that ran the pilot and want the candidate side worked too.
offers.promise: The dormant candidates in your ATS, re-engaged for the roles you have open now.
youGet: Dormant candidates matched to your open roles and re-engaged in your recruiter's voice.
Interested candidates handed over with their current status and availability.
youGive: Read access to candidates and open roles in your ATS.

offers.name: Free consultation and audit
offers.audience: Firms where someone retypes the same client into several tools by hand.
offers.promise: One page back: where the repeated hours go and what to fix first.
youGet: A 30-minute call where you walk me through one normal week.
One page back: each repeated job, the hours it takes a week, and what to automate first.
youGive: 30 minutes and a screen share. No access to anything.
weGet: The chance to quote the build.
offers.guarantee: The page is yours whether or not we build anything.

offers.name: AI integration build
offers.audience: Owner-led firms, about 10 to 50 people, whose work lives in people's heads and data sits in five places.
offers.promise: I figure out how your firm runs, fix what leaks, connect your data into one CRM, then put AI to work on it.
youGet: Figure out: every core process written down as a plain SOP, from watching a normal week.
Fix: the steps that leak time or deals cut, with one agreed way to do each thing.
Connect: your ATS or CRM, inboxes, calendars and spreadsheets cleaned into one CRM.
Put AI to work: AI jobs on that data, watched and fixed, one new one every month on the retainer.
youGive: An hour with you and 45 minutes with three or four of your team in the first two weeks.
offers.guarantee: If something I built breaks because of my mistake, I fix it free.
